slug: 2024-09-06 Libya's Project Intilaqa matches Civil Registry electronic data with paper records

LBY.note: No exchange between civil register and ID system is stated.
Only households (1.8 million, 97%) are counted, not people holding a national ID number.
No number at birth is stated.

facts.fact: The Civil Registry Authority, a national body, issues the unique National ID Number to all Libyan nationals, per the Libya Herald.

LBY.note: No public register is said to be keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The Civil Registry Authority issues a unique National ID Number to all Libyan nationals, needed for a SIM, passport, bank account or vote; the Libya Herald also recalls a leaked estimate of 250,000-700,000 fake numbers.
